content.text: Mweshi mwe mugwêrhwe n’enyôrha, muyishe ebwa mîshi;
ciru na ninyu mwe murhagwêrhi nsaranga, muyishe!
Mugule munanywe amamvu n’amarhà buzira nsaranga na buzira kulyûla bici!
Cirhuma muheza ensaranga oku gurhali mugati munarhindibukire ebirhayîgusa?
Munyumvîrhize lyo mukaz’irya ebinunu, munacîshinge omu kulya ebishushagîre.
Murhege okurhwiri munayishe emunda ndi; muyumvîrhize lyo mubona akalamo!
Nafundika endagâno y’ensiku n’amango
haguma ninyu,
yo mihigo erhakahingûlwa nalaganyagya Daudi.
Loli oku ye nayimanzize, namujira muhamîrizi w’amashanja,
muluzi w’okurhambula embaga.
Alà oku wahamagala ishanja orhayishi,
n’ishanja lirhakuyishi lyakulibirhira
erhi Nyakasane Nyamuzinda wâwe orhuma,
Mutagatîfu w’Israheli, ye wakuhîre irenge.
Mulongereze Nyakasane oku aciri aboneka,
mumushenge oku aciri hôfi.
Omubî aleke okwâge, na nyankola-maligo akabulire enkengêro zâge,
agaluke emwa Nyakasane, naye amubabalira,
agaluke emwa Nyamuzinda wîrhu,
bulya abà wa bwonjo bunji.
Bulya enkengêro zâni zirhali zo nkengêro zinyu,
n’enjira zâni zirhali zo njira zinyu, kwo adesire Nyakasane
Nka kula amalunga gali kulî enyanya ly’igulu,
kwo enjira zâni ziri kulî n’enjira zinyu,
kwo n’enkengêro zâni ziri kulî enyanya ly’enkengêro zinyu.

content: Nka kula enkuba n’olubula birhoga emalunga birhanagalukayo birhanaj’ibombêza idaho n’okuliyêza n’okumezâmwo emburho, lihe omurhwêzi emyâka n’oshalisire eci alya,
ntyo kwo nalo luli oluderho lurhenga omu kanwa kâni: lurhankangalukira busha, ci lwanajira eci nalonzagya, lunayûkirize oku lwarhumagwa.
Nêci, mwâgenda muyunjwire bushagaluke munaje nwayêrekwa enjira y’omurhûla; entondo n’orhurhondo byâkaz’immukomera kagasha, n’emirhi yoshi y’erubala ekûbize.
Ahantu harhasâg’imera mishûgi hakola hamera ensindani, n’ahantu hàmeraga olushusha hakola hamera omurhi gw’obukù. Lyâbà irenge kuli Nyakasane na cimanyîso cirhazâzika ensiku n’amango.

footnotes.text: 55, 3 Endagâno y’ensiku n’amango: yo ndagâno mpyâhya: Lolà muli Yer 31, 31.
